fail.message: A test-tree report from an EARLIER run could not be deleted and is still in target/, so this run cannot be told apart from that one: after a failure before the guard, those files would be read as this run's verdict, which is the staleness this step exists to prevent (HD-343). The delete cannot fail the build by itself - Ant's quiet attribute also switches failonerror off - so this refusal is the only thing that says so. WHAT TO DO: something is holding a file open. Close an editor viewing target/test-tree-summary.md, target/missing-test-classes.txt or target/missing-test-files.txt, stop any other Maven run in this directory, then re-run; if nothing obvious holds it, `mvnw clean` removes the whole directory.

A suite in this run cannot be shown to have executed the whole tree it is answerable for, so its result is not evidence about whatever it left out. The [test-tree] (backend) and [vitest-tree] (SPA) report above says which, and what is missing; HD-265, HD-301.
